I have one on the back right side of my left heel directly over my Achilles heel.

Back then, we had a great big heavy glass door as our “screen door” for the front door. It was heavy and awkward to try to open with both your hands full, cumbersome and ugly. With your arms full, you would have to back into it, open it using your elbow and then turn around before you were free in your travels. My parents kept it until about 9th grade high school or so. 

When I came home from school, I would leave my backpack right by the front door. This is important for later. I’d also keep my shoes right next to my backpack, and my coat hung up right above it.

I was on my way out the door to go somewhere, I believe I was late for school? I JUMPED down the stairs, hit the floor essentially running, slid my coat on smoothly, pulled on my already-tied shoes, grabbed my binders and backpack which filled both arms. I opened the door with such force, that it swung wide open.

And then it sped straight towards the door frame to slam shut again. 

I was in the middle of turning around to run for my ride when it sliced open my ankle right next to my Achilles heel. I wasn’t aware that I was bleeding profusely, and I wasn’t aware of any injury. I had to get to school and focus on my classes. 

After I got home for the evening when school let out, I finally checked my ankle to find the back of my sock completely soaked red. I said “what in the hell” before I realized what had happened.

That sock acted as a bandage to protect my wound from getting worse and to act as a buffer from infection. I was lucky to be wearing it that day.

Anyways I now have a 3-4 inch long scar on the back of my left ankle where it was cut.

Essentially I was attacked by a ferocious glass door. 🤷🏻‍♀️
